_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/damrak_noord.json — RoomSpec for Damrak (the city, district 6: Damrak): the north half of Damrak, along the basin: the tour boats tied up at their pontoons (the water high, the flood came up it), across the water the old houses that have settled every way on their piles, their windows lit; the hotels and shops on the street side; and ahead, over the Prins Hendrikkade, Centraal Station, floodlit. Modelled after openly licensed photographs; every business name is made up, the landmarks keep theirs. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor (street.py, city.py and landmarks.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).
